claims: Third-seeded Illinois defeated second-seeded Houston 65-55 on March 26, 2026.
The game was in the NCAA Tournament Sweet 16.
Illinois advanced to the Elite Eight to face Iowa.
David Mirkovic recorded 14 points and 10 rebounds for Illinois.
The game was at Toyota Center, Houston, TX.
David Mirkovic scored 14 points for Illinois.
Keaton Wagler scored 13 points for Illinois.
Andrej Stojakovic scored 13 points for Illinois.
Following a tie in the second half, Illinois used a 17-0 run to build a 44-26 lead, according to University of Illinois Athletics.
Writing Illini reports that Illinois held Houston to 34.4% shooting.
Illinois faces #9 seed Iowa in the Elite Eight on Saturday.
KTVB noted that 55 points was Houston's lowest point total of the season.
Keaton Wagler recorded 10 points and 12 rebounds for Illinois.
This was Illinois's 11th Elite Eight appearance in program history, as detailed in University of Illinois Athletics.
Illinois had a 43-34 rebounding edge, according to Sports Illustrated.
Illinois maintained control for 86% of the game, according to Sports Illustrated
